text: Computer vision is a type of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand pictures and videos. One important part of computer vision is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a photo, such as an animal or a person. Another key part is object detection, which means finding and locating specific things in an image. Computer vision has many applications in daily life. For example, it is used in self-driving cars to help them see the road, recognize other vehicles, and avoid accidents. It is also used in security cameras and medical imaging. Computer vision is changing the way machines interact with the world.
